params.name: query
params.description: The query provided by the user as free-form text.

params.name: key
params.description: The key of the index to use.

params.name: thread_id
params.description: A unique identifier for the conversation thread. This ID links multiple requests to the same conversation.

params.name: pre_filter_expression
params.description: A URL-encoded JSON string containing filters (inaccessible to end users) used to narrow the result set. Applied before filters accessible to end users. Does not affect facet counts. Only results that match the filters are returned. More details on https://docs.constructor.com/reference/shared-pre-filter-expressions

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain specifying a set of specific instructions for processing the intent, e.g., 'recipes', 'sportsgear'.

params.name: guard
params.description: Enable or disable the moderation check.

params.name: num_result_events
params.description: The maximum number of result events to return.

params.name: num_results_per_page
params.description: **Deprecated. Please, use ``num_results_per_event`` instead.**

params.name: num_results_per_event
params.description: The maximum number of results to return per ``search_result`` event.

params.name: fmt_options
params.description: An object containing options to format different aspects of the response.

params.name: qs
params.description: A URL-encoded JSON string. More details on https://docs.constructor.com/reference/search-search-results#using-the-qs-parameter

params.name: c
params.description: The id of the client and version that the request is coming from, such as `cio-js-2.90`.

params.name: us
params.description: A customer defined context (such as `vip-club-member`) used to evaluate redirect or refined tag rules. Pass multiple segments by passing multiple `us` arguments.

params.name: ui
params.description: A customer generated anonymized identifier for a user on a customer website. It should only be sent for logged in customers and helps constructor to tie multiple client and session ID's together to form a behavioral data profile across devices.

params.name: s
params.description: An integer representing the users session number (starting with `1`), incremented after a 30 minute period of inactivity.

params.name: i
params.description: A globally unique identifier for the user browser (or mobile application instance) making the request.

items.docs: Retrieves AI powered product discovery suggestions based on conversational free-form text. Returns results in small batches using a real time [Server-sent Events](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events/Using_server-sent_events) stream for a dynamic user experience.

items.docs: Retrieves AI powered answers to questions for a given item. If the client accepts [server-sent events](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events/Using_server-sent_events) (text/event-stream content) response will be streamed back, otherwise complete response JSON is returned.
